name: 欠席申請の承認
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Japanese Lighthouse LH11-0017 欠席申請の承認 view. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source controls checkbox/triangle/button geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls, ahead of rough SECONDARY Japanese mock Image2. Image3 approved bus is white surfaces/forest-gradient style only. Preserve the existing localized volunteer approval content; source HR entitlement/balance table is outside this domain adaptation, do not introduce96hour balances, employment figures or foreign names/photos.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact logical640px wide white rounded approval panel with fine neutral boundary and soft shadow; height may grow modestly to preserve all restored controls/readability. Small forest link 「プロフィールへ戻る」, then Meiryo Bold20/28 heading 「欠席の申請」 and quiet12/16 「山田 太郎」. A white neutral-outline day-details section. Restore original bulk-control row: small white buttons 「選択」 and 「種類を設定」 with small downward triangles, and forest text link 「内訳を閉じる」 at right. Two daily rows, each with a small EMPTY square checkbox: first date 「10月18日（日）」, white type dropdown 「欠席」, white time selectors 「09:00」 and 「12:00」 with a dash between; second date 「10月19日（月）」 and white type dropdown 「担当なし」, no invented times. All caret triangles small/source-faithful/slate. Keep existing dates/type/time values; no new duration metrics or balances. Fine neutral row separators, no broad gray/mint panel.
Below, bold14/24 「担当者のコメント」, then exact regular14/24 two lines 「受付の担当をお休みします。」 / 「引き継ぎは済んでいます。」. No invented photo/identity. White neutral-outline reply field label 「リーダーの回答」, exact value 「申請を確認しました。」. Footer primary forest-gradient 「承認して通知」 and quieter WHITE neutral-outline 「差し戻して通知」. Restore small source help-link anatomy beneath as Japanese 「欠席申請について」. No extra close X outside the source component crop.
Meiryo14/24 body regular,12/16 metadata, zero tracking; preserve existing role hierarchy and wrapping. Source purple actions/links become forest-green; primary smooth135degree #174C36 → #1F6444 at58% → #2D8F5E, white legible label, gentle edge light, restrained shadow. Checkboxes remain unchecked, white with neutral outline; supporting glyphs slate#526173. Type fields and all ordinary surfaces white. Decline/correction is a secondary neutral decision, do not invent red destructive styling. No random icon colors, mint chips, neon, gloss, invented metrics or app chrome. Preserve original fine controls over mock omissions. Static raster design candidate only; no real approval/notification behavior or entitlement data claimed.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で日別未選択箱/種類と時刻の下三角/選択・種類設定・内訳閉じる/戻る・補助リンクを復元。保存日本語/日付/09–12時/担当なし/本人二行/回答/承認と差戻通知を保持。HR残時間や別人写真は奉仕適応外として追加なし。白面/森林緑/中立/切れなしを実見。実承認・通知・権限・正確な書体同定は未検証。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
